title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Identity Verification and Reopening Review Requirements
content:
Two review requirements of Unemployment Benefit Claims differ by program: whether the claim requires its own identity verification case before payment, and whether a reopened claim reporting a new separation of the listed review kinds is placed on hold for a separation determination.

| Program | Own identity verification case required before payment | Reopened claim with a new reviewable separation placed on hold for a separation determination |
|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | Yes | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | Yes | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | Yes | Yes |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | Yes | Yes |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | No | No |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | No | No |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | Yes | No |
